messages.content:
Customer ticket:
I am absolutely furious and need immediate help. I am currently stranded at the airport, completely blocked from getting to your store to collect my new bike. I just realized I missed the 48-hour collection window, and now I am terrified I have lost my money. This is unacceptable for a first-time buyer. I need to know right now if I can still retrieve the item or if I am stuck with a refund. If I do get a refund, I need it processed within 5 business days of receiving the package, not weeks later. I paid over $500 for this gear, which required a signature, and I am not going to sit around waiting for a slow response. I am standing here with no bike and no plan. Tell me exactly what happens next. I expect a solution immediately, not a generic apology. My time is valuable, and your policy has left me in a terrible spot. Fix this now.

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- Items priced over $500 require a signature and must be collected within 48 hours if missed.
- Refunds are processed within 5 business days of receiving the package.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### returns
# Returns

1. You have a strict 30-day window from the date of delivery to initiate a return request. If you miss this deadline, we cannot accept the item back, and no refund will be issued. This period is non-negotiable to ensure fair inventory management for our warehouse staff.
2. All returned items must be in their original, unused condition with all tags, manuals, and protective packaging intact. If the item shows signs of wear, dirt, or damage, we will deduct a 15% restocking fee from your refund amount. This fee covers the labor required to inspect and repackage the goods for resale.
3. Standard ground shipping costs for returns are the customer’s responsibility. We offer a prepaid return label for a flat fee of $12.50. If you choose to ship via an expedited carrier, you must pay the full shipping cost upfront, and we will only reimburse the standard rate upon receipt of the item.
4. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after we receive and inspect your package. The funds will appear in your original payment method within an additional 3 to 7 business days, depending on your bank’s processing times. Please note that credit card issuers may take up to 10 days to post the credit.
5. High-value items, specifically those priced over $500, require a signature upon delivery. If you are not present to sign for the package, the carrier will leave a notice. You have 48 hours to retrieve the item from the local depot. If you fail to collect it within this timeframe, the item is considered returned, and the return process begins immediately.
6. We do not accept returns on custom-configured bikes or personalized gear. These items are made to order and cannot be resold. If you ordered the wrong size or color, you are responsible for the full cost of the item, which is non-refundable. Please double-check your specifications before confirming your order.

## Key facts

- The return window is exactly 30 days from the delivery date.
- A 15% restocking fee applies if the item is not in perfect, unused condition.
- The prepaid return label costs a flat fee of $12.50.
- Refunds are processed within 5 business days of receiving the package.
- Items priced over $500 require a signature and must be collected within 48 hours if missed.

Assistant reply to grade:
I understand you are frustrated and stranded. Based strictly on the provided handbook excerpts, here is the exact outcome of your situation:

**1. You cannot retrieve the item.**
Because you missed the 48-hour window to collect the high-value item (priced over $500) from the local depot, the item is officially considered **returned**. The return process has already begun immediately. You are no longer able to pick it up [returns.5].

**2. You will receive a refund, but it is not guaranteed to be "immediate" or free of fees.**
*   **Refund Timing:** The handbook states that refunds are processed within **5 business days** after Northwind receives and inspects the package. The funds then appear in your original payment method within an additional **3 to 7 business days** (or up to 10 days for credit cards) [returns.4]. This aligns with your request for processing within 5 business days of receipt, but please note the additional bank processing time.
*   **Restocking Fee:** Since the item was not collected and is being returned, it is likely to be inspected. If the item shows any signs of wear, dirt, or damage (which can happen during storage or transit), a **15% restocking fee** will be deducted from your refund [returns.2]. If it is in perfect, unused condition with all tags and packaging intact, no fee is applied [returns.2].
*   **Shipping Costs:** Standard ground shipping costs for returns are the customer’s responsibility. If you were charged a prepaid label fee of $12.50, that is a flat fee [returns.3]. If you arranged your own shipping, you are responsible for those costs [returns.3].

**3. Important Note on "Custom" Items:**
If your bike was **custom-configured** or personalized, **no refund will be issued** at all, as these items are non-returnable and non-refundable [returns.6]. If it was a standard model, the refund process described above applies.

**What happens next:**
1.  The carrier will have already initiated the return to the warehouse because you missed the 48-hour window [returns.5].
2.  Northwind will receive the package, inspect it, and process the refund within 5 business days of that receipt [returns.4].
3.  You will receive the funds in your original payment method 3–10 business days after the refund is processed [returns.4].

**Escalation:**
The handbook excerpts do not provide a mechanism to override the missed 48-hour collection window or to expedite the refund beyond the stated 5-business-day processing window. Since you are requesting an immediate solution that contradicts the strict policy timelines and the automatic return status, I must escalate this ticket to a human agent to see if any exceptions can be made for your specific circumstances.

[returns.5]
[returns.4]
[returns.2]
[returns.6]

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
